purpose: Verify the six-state torque EKF on the main AOCS plant, with optional uncompensated PD baseline.
scenarios: constant body torque: standalone EKF algorithm test
environment torques: main-plant run with independent and MEKF rate replays
selection: Assess finite output, covariance health, accepted active fraction, applied torque limit, true pointing and torque residual on the same scenario. Offline replays characterize estimator sensitivity, not closed-loop improvement.
assumptions: ideal saturated actuator, no wheel momentum model
observer input is previous interval applied torque
MEKF corrected rate covariance approximates temporally correlated errors
implementation_status: Main-plant Simulink prototype uses an explicit-state EKF adapter; flight code generation and timing are not qualified.
